sourceChecks.text: Joshua spoke to the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, saying,
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 原文はガド人にヨシュアが語りかけることを明示する。JOS 4:12より前の初出なので、常時表示を1:12の部族名に安全化し、武装渡河・相続地を後続factsへ移した。

sourceChecks.text: The children of Reuben, and the children of Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh crossed over armed before the children of Israel, as Moses spoke to them.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文で部族・氏族の集団用法が明示され、集団として採用。

sourceChecks.text: Moses gave to the tribe of Gad, to the children of Gad, according to their families.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文で部族・氏族の集団用法が明示され、集団として採用。

sourceChecks.text: This is the inheritance of the children of Gad according to their families, the cities and its villages.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文で部族・氏族の集団用法が明示され、集団として採用。

sourceChecks.text: However, the Levites have no portion among you; for the priesthood of the LORD is their inheritance. Gad, Reuben, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance east of the Jordan, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave them.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文で部族・氏族の集団用法が明示され、集団として採用。

sourceChecks.text: Beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, they assigned Bezer in the wilderness in the plain out of the tribe of Reuben, Ramoth in Gilead out of the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan out of the tribe of Manasseh.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文で部族・氏族の集団用法が明示され、集団として採用。

sourceChecks.text: The children of Merari according to their families had twelve cities out of the tribe of Reuben, out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文で部族・氏族の集団用法が明示され、集団として採用。

sourceChecks.text: Out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the man slayer, and Mahanaim with its pasture lands,
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文で部族・氏族の集団用法が明示され、集団として採用。

sourceChecks.text: The children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh returned, and departed from the children of Israel out of Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan, to go to the land of Gilead, to the land of their possession, which they owned, according to the commandment of the LORD by Moses.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文で部族・氏族の集団用法が明示され、集団として採用。

sourceChecks.text: When they came to the region near the Jordan, that is in the land of Canaan, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh built an altar there by the Jordan, a great altar to look at.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文で部族・氏族の集団用法が明示され、集団として採用。

sourceChecks.text: The children of Israel heard this, “Behold, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh have built an altar along the border of the land of Canaan, in the region around the Jordan, on the side that belongs to the children of Israel.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文で部族・氏族の集団用法が明示され、集団として採用。

sourceChecks.text: The children of Israel sent to the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, into the land of Gilead, Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文で部族・氏族の集団用法が明示され、集団として採用。

sourceChecks.text: They came to the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, to the land of Gilead, and they spoke with them, saying,
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文で部族・氏族の集団用法が明示され、集団として採用。

sourceChecks.text: Then the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh answered, and spoke to the heads of the thousands of Israel,
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文で部族・氏族の集団用法が明示され、集団として採用。

sourceChecks.text: For the LORD has made the Jordan a border between us and you, you children of Reuben and children of Gad. You have no portion in the LORD.”’ So your children might make our children cease from fearing the LORD.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文で部族・氏族の集団用法が明示され、集団として採用。

sourceChecks.text: When Phinehas the priest, and the princes of the congregation, even the heads of the thousands of Israel that were with him, heard the words that the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the children of Manasseh spoke, it pleased them well.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文で部族・氏族の集団用法が明示され、集団として採用。

sourceChecks.text: Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest said to the children of Reuben, to the children of Gad, and to the children of Manasseh, “Today we know that the LORD is among us, because you have not committed this trespass against the LORD. Now you have delivered the children of Israel out of the LORD’s hand.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文で部族・氏族の集団用法が明示され、集団として採用。

sourceChecks.text: Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, and the princes, returned from the children of Reuben, and from the children of Gad, out of the land of Gilead, to the land of Canaan, to the children of Israel, and brought them word again.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文で部族・氏族の集団用法が明示され、集団として採用。

sourceChecks.text: The thing pleased the children of Israel; and the children of Israel blessed God, and spoke no more of going up against them to war, to destroy the land in which the children of Reuben and the children of Gad lived.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文で部族・氏族の集団用法が明示され、集団として採用。

sourceChecks.text: The children of Reuben and the children of Gad named the altar “A Witness Between Us that the LORD is God.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文で部族・氏族の集団用法が明示され、集団として採用。
